title: Lyra Workflow Schema
description: Defines an orchestration workflow or playbook representing the steps Lyra takes to resolve user intents.

workflow_id.description: Unique identifier for the workflow playbook.

description.description: Summary of the dialogue flow and business purpose.

intents.description: List of customer intents mapped to trigger this workflow.

config.description: Parameters, capability references, prompts, or conditional expressions.

x-intendedUse: Authoritative validation of playbooks and workflows loaded into the Conversation and Workflow Engines.
